description:
An intimate and profound investigation of the spiritual aftershocks of the 9/11 attacks. (Aired 2002)

This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb

And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

For many people, the most difficult questions after the deadly terror attacks on Sept. 11, 2001, were not about politics, military strategy, or homeland security. They were questions about God, evil and the potential for darkness within religion itself. And for many, those questions didn’t go away.

In “Faith and Doubt at Ground Zero,” FRONTLINE producer Helen Whitney set out to discover how the religious beliefs of Americans were challenged a year after the attacks.

title: The Spiritual Questions People Grappled With a Year After 9/11 (full documentary) | FRONTLINE (PBS)
